articles.summary: Originally a packet filter, eBPF now supports comprehensive observability, security, and performance optimization. By running custom programs directly in the kernel, eBPF enables real-time data insights with minimal overhead, making it ideal for high-performance, cloud-native environments.
articles.title: eBPF based instrumentation
